EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in Communication at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Future Sun Devil,
Thank you for expressing interest in the Communication (BA: https://newcollege.asu.edu/communication-degree-ba OR BS:https://newcollege.asu.edu/communication-degree ) program at Arizona State University. The course work and faculty-led research projects in the communication program cover personal relationships, conflict resolution, social media and technology, global communication, communication philosophy, and risk and crisis communication. Students explore communication in organizations and interpersonal relationships; in public, political and social situations; and across cultures. Student’s usually look to work in Advertising, Marketing, Public Relations, Editing, Copy Writing, and Media Relations among many others. By viewing the major map (https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/roadmaps/ASU00/ASCOMMBS/null/ALL/2016d), you can see the degree requirements outlined for graduation.
Be sure to review our admission and application requirements (https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/roadmaps/ASU00/ASCOMMBS/null/ALL/2016) for more information about the application process in an easy to follow format. For finding more ways to pay for college, please visit our scholarships page (https://newcollege.asu.edu/college-scholarships).
It's important to find the right fit for your undergraduate program. A great way to learn more about this degree is to register for one of our upcoming information sessions. You can visit ASU and register for a tour (https://visit.asu.edu/).
We can’t wait to see you here at West campus! If you have any questions about New College, West campus, or one of our 35 programs, please contact our Recruitment Office through the information listed below. Thank you, and we’ll talk to you soon!
Kindest Regards,
New College Recruitment Team New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences Arizona State University, West campus asknewcollege@asu.edu 602-543-2890
